inside of the editor when you go to import a model already existing as an outliner, it lets you go through all the dialog to fail. [js.err] [dispatch] error id=6088 type=onClick: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length') TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')
    at meshAppendGroup (<anonymous>:73136:146)
    at Object.appendPart (<anonymous>:73979:20)
    at <anonymous>:89051:67
    at withNativeMeshActionSource (<anonymous>:84534:14)
    at importModelAsParts (<anonymous>:89051:22)
    at onPress (<anonymous>:84674:24)
    at dispatchAliases (<anonymous>:90629:9)
    at globalThis.__dispatchEvent (<anonymous>:90676:7)
    at <anonymous>:1:1
resolution: Fixed Add From Library importing a saved model as Outliner parts. The extractor returned {vertices, faceGroups} while AppFrame passed geo.positions, causing meshAppendGroup to read undefined.length. Aligned the extraction contract to {positions, faceGroups}, updated its tests, added triangle/stride/group-count validation before the host append door, and only close the picker after at least one part imports successfully. All 10 mesh-document tests and the ReleaseFast editor build pass.
